summary: encode_into increments a u32 input counter without checking overflow. With 2^32 non-ASCII characters, it panics when overflow checks are enabled, or wraps to zero and incorrectly returns success when checks are disabled. The fix uses checked_add to return Err(()) instead and adds early length guards to the public wrappers. The reversal restores only the counter changes. The fix-added test requires a 64-bit target and explicit execution with --ignored because it is marked slow.
